scientific.integrity: The all-support result is proved from Parseval, a complete pair-sum collision classification, and a two-angle minimization. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific.limitations: The theorem concerns exactly four distinct integer frequencies with unit-modulus coefficients at the fourth moment; finite cyclic torsion, unequal magnitudes, other exponents, and larger supports are not covered.

title: Sharp fourth-moment phase range for four-frequency unimodular trigonometric polynomials
